tex_content.html:
Definition

For smooth manifolds $M$ and $N$ with or without boundary, a map $F:M\to N$ is a local diffeomorphism if every $p\in M$ has a neighborhood $U$ such that $F(U)$ is open in $N$ and $F|_U:U\to F(U)$ is a diffeomorphism.
